phase: ROADMAP Stage 5 backfill: real anonymized query-set INTAKE SCAFFOLD v1. The original '50-100 real anonymized query set' item remains UNCHECKED — no real set exists; only the intake/validation scaffold is delivered.
summary: Added a deterministic, stdlib-only intake scaffold for a real anonymized query set, WITHOUT fabricating any real data. load_real_query_set loads {metadata, cases}; validate_real_query_set enforces structure, anonymization (rejects PII/secret field names and PII-shaped values in free text, reporting only the matched kind — never the raw value), and provenance (source/collected_at/anonymized=true); summarize_real_query_readiness classifies the set as invalid/template/incomplete_real/ready_real/oversized_real, and can NEVER classify a placeholder/synthetic or under-50 set as ready_real. A human-fill template (tests/data/real_query_set_template.json, clearly marked is_template with 2 example rows) and a CLI (tools/validate_real_query_set.py) are included. The original ROADMAP item stays unchecked; a sub-note records the scaffold as done.
implemented: backend/server.py: load_real_query_set(path) (raises ValueError on non-object / missing cases).

backend/server.py: validate_real_query_set(dataset) enforcing unique case ids, non-empty query, provenance (source/collected_at/anonymized=true), >=1 relevance target, no forbidden PII/secret field names, and no PII-shaped value in query/notes/context (error text carries only the matched kind, never the raw value); returns has_placeholder_marker.
backend/server.py: summarize_real_query_readiness(dataset) classifying invalid/template/incomplete_real/ready_real/oversized_real; placeholder/synthetic marker or <50 cases can never be ready_real.
tools/validate_real_query_set.py: CLI (--set/--json) exit 0 only when status==ready_real, else 1, load-error 2; never prints raw PII.
tests/data/real_query_set_template.json: clearly-marked is_template dataset (2 example rows) with schema docs for humans to fill.

tests/test_real_query_intake.py: 16 tests (template valid-but-not-ready, 50 clean cases ready, <50 incomplete, >100 oversized, synthetic/placeholder marker blocks ready, PII field/value rejection without leaking value, id-card rejection, missing provenance/anonymized/target, duplicate id, load error, CLI exit 1 on template).
tools/run_quality_gates.py: py-compile gate now includes tests/test_real_query_intake.py and tools/validate_real_query_set.py.
README.md documents the scaffold and its honesty boundary; docs/ROADMAP.md keeps the original 50-100 real-set item UNCHECKED and adds a checked sub-note for the intake scaffold only.

risks: The scaffold validates that supplied data looks anonymized and carries provenance; it cannot prove data is truly real or truly de-identified — a determined submitter could pass shape checks with fabricated-but-clean rows, so ready_real means 'shape/anonymization/provenance OK', not 'audited genuine'.

PII detection is pattern-based (mainland-China id/phone + generic email) and field-name based; unusual PII formats or PII embedded in unexpected fields could slip past. It is a safety net, not a guarantee.

Placeholder-marker detection is token-based; a real set that happens to contain a token like '示例' in a legitimate query would be flagged as template (false positive) and must be reworded or the token list revisited.
Readiness is a mechanical count+marker check; it does not assess query quality, coverage, or representativeness.

Environment note: the local interpreter is python3 (no bare 'python' on PATH); the quality-gate runner honors PYTHON=python3, and a local 'python->python3' PATH shim lets its default-interpreter meta-test pass.
credentials: No credentials or .env files were read, created, or modified; validators reject api_key/secret/password/token field names and never echo a matched PII value.
No external network calls or model calls were used for implementation or local tests.
No push performed; commit/push left to the maintainer.
